_staticRedirects_basis_s6h_scissor: 1.21.5 RenderSystem.enableScissor / disableScissor set SCISSOR_STATE, which RenderType draws and GuiGraphics' draws (through RenderTypes, GuiGraphics.applyScissor -> RenderSystem.enableScissor) alike copied into their pass (javap). 1.21.6 splits it: RenderType draws read enableScissorForRenderTypeDraws' state, GuiGraphics' deferred elements record GuiGraphics.ScissorStack.peek() and GuiRenderer maps it to pixels with 1.21.5's applyScissor formula (javap method_70884). rt/CbScissor calls the 1.21.6 render-type method (the methodRenames in s6g-scissor.json still carry mixins on the 1.21.5 member onto it) and, while the frame's GUI is built, stands as ScissorStack.peek()'s answer until GuiGraphics changes its stack (CbGuiScissorMixin / CbGuiScissorFrameMixin).
